remarks: Welcome to resort-style living in the heart of Camarillo! Set within a highly desirable gated community, this beautiful end-unit condominium combines spacious interiors, inviting outdoor areas, and an impressive collection of amenities designed for comfortable, connected living. Step inside to soaring ceilings, abundant natural light, and a welcoming floor plan that flows effortlessly from room to room. The spacious living room centers around a cozy fireplace and opens to a charming private patio, creating an inviting space for quiet mornings, relaxed evenings, or casual entertaining.
